test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 13 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Find the single discount equivalent to two successive discounts of 10% and 5%.
solution:
Given:

2 successive discounts of 10% and 5%.

Calculations:

Effective discount for a% and b% discounts = a% + b% - (ab/100)%

Effective discount for 10% and 5% discounts = 10% + 5% - {(10 × 5)/100}%

⇒ 15% - 0.50%

⇒ 14.50%

∴ Equivalent percent is 14.50%.
